test_case.test_name: One-shot UMC correctable ODECC injection with secure OOB/in-band CPER correlation
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved correctable on-die ECC event into the mapped UMC/HBM target and prove OOB and in-band CPER identify the same OAM, UMC bank, ext0 HBMEccErr and Corrected severity without collateral faults.
required_package: Signed AMD/FAE mapping of d0/b0/s2/t2/address 0x800000000 to physical GPU/OAM/UMC
Compatible amdgpuras, firmware/driver, Redfish schema and cdump_analyzer versions/checksums
Dedicated isolated SUT, maintenance authorization, full health baseline and independent console/reboot recovery
Authenticated TLS paginated Dump/CPER access, secure transfer and immutable evidence storage
Expected one-event cardinality, in-band identity rules and collateral-error/abort policy
test_case.test_command: RAS-INJECTION GATE CLOSED until all prerequisites and just-in-time approval are signed. Preserve complete OOB/in-band/system baselines. Execute exactly once `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 2 -a 0x800000000` on the mapped target; capture full streams/exit and health timeline. Enumerate all post CPER entries through authenticated pagination, bind the new attachment by stable identity/time, transfer securely, hash/decode it, and compare every required OOB field with `amdgpuras -C`. No clear, max-ID shortcut, plaintext transport or reinjection.
test_case.expected_result: The one approved command succeeds; exactly the approved new event set is causally bound to the injection, decoded OOB CPER reports the mapped OAM, UMC, ext0 HBMEccErr and Corrected severity, in-band identity/severity agrees, and no unexpected platform fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed mapping/versions/approval, one successful injection, complete pre/post manifests, secure verified attachment/decode, all exact fields and in-band agreement with clean collateral health. FAIL on wrong/unknown target, command failure, missing/extra event, any field mismatch, evidence gap, GPU/system instability or recovery fault. Missing prerequisites is NOT READY.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until approved tool, mapping, isolated SUT and tested recovery exist; explicit approval is required immediately before injection.
Execute exactly once and monitor GPU/system/RAS health continuously.
Preserve every event and raw attachment before analysis; never clear or acknowledge evidence.
Stop on anomaly and never automatically reinject or reboot.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, signed mapping and tool/firmware/schema/analyzer matrix
Isolation/authorization/recovery check and complete OOB/in-band/system baseline
Exact one-shot command, stdout/stderr/exit and timestamped health timeline
Complete pre/post CPER manifests plus secure attachment identity/hash/raw/decode
OAM/UMC/ext0/HBMEccErr/Corrected and in-band equality matrix with collateral audit
No-clear/no-secret/no-reinjection audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
